import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,e,g,h,w,f,k,m = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return a*t + b*P*np.log(P) + c/P + e*t/P + (g*s + h*cc)/P + f*np.log(t)/P + k*np.log(P) + m*P
